title: Design it simple
sub: Film 3 of 4 of A plan in ninety days: define, the target state. In Korea in the 1440s, King Sejong made 28 letters anyone could learn in days, from a few shapes and one rule. A year from now, Helena Novak, a university's new data manager, and her team design the target from five principles: a small team in the middle with data partners around it, six procedures of a page each, and one front door.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster. Its colours mean the same in every film of the module: blue is design and plans, green done or value, amber risk, cost or waiting, orange data, and violet only an agent.
